Python (programming language)

For other uses, see Python.
ParadigmMulti-paradigm

Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.[1] Its design emphasizes code readability.

History[edit]

Python 2.0 was released in 2000. Python 2.7.18, released in 2020, was the last release of Python 2.

  • Python 3.0 was released on December 3, 2008.

  • It was a major revision.
